operators.name: custom_hardtanh
semantics: Applies hardtanh elementwise: y = min(max(x, min_val), max_val).
Preserves shape, dtype and device; supports strides (operates on contiguous or strided tensor, output matches input layout).
No broadcasting beyond elementwise; no in-place modification.

operators.name: custom_max_pool2d
semantics: 2D max pooling over each channel independently with kernel_size=(2,2), stride=(2,2), padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False.
Output shape calculation: floor((320 + 2*0 - 1*(2-1) -1)/2 + 1) = 160.
For each output position (n,c,h,w), takes max over input window [h*stride + dh, w*stride + dw] for dh,dw in [0,kernel_size-1].
No padding means windows stay inside input; no implicit zero padding.
Preserves batch and channel dims; output dtype float32, device cuda.

operators.name: custom_flatten
semantics: Flattens dimensions starting from start_dim=1: shape [512,1,160,160] -> [512, 1*160*160 = 25600].
Preserves row-major memory order semantics: values in output are in the same order as the contiguous view of input.
If input is non-contiguous, first makes it contiguous (or handles strides accordingly) before flattening.
Result is contiguous with stride [25600,1].

operators.name: custom_linear
semantics: Performs linear transformation: y = x @ weight.T + bias (bias broadcast over rows).
Reference linear uses bias=True, so bias is always provided (non-None).
Input x shape [N, in_features=25600], weight shape [out_features=512, in_features=25600], output [N, 512].
Uses cuBLAS GEMM or equivalent; transposes weight logically (row-major).
If bias is not None, adds bias to each output row; if None, no bias addition.
Preserves dtype and device.
Hardtanh elementwise with min_val=-1.0, max_val=1.0.
Input shape [512,1,320,320] -> output same shape.
No broadcasting; elementwise operation.
MaxPool2d with kernel_size=(2,2), stride=(2,2), padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False.
No padding; each 2x2 non-overlapping window max.
Output is contiguous, values in same order.
Linear with weight [512,25600], bias [512].
Computes x @ weight.T + bias, output shape [512,512].
Final output is the tensor returned from linear, shape [512,512].
